Why Hydrotel exists

A screen that behaves like nature.

Hydrotel explores what a phone can feel like when its optical surface is fluid, responsive and visibly alive.

HydroScreen

Water replaces the crystal.

A thin sealed channel holds clear water over a light-emitting backplane. Tiny pulses shape refraction as the interface moves.
